solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Behind health centre, place for allotment

indicators.note: Behind says the word for place comes after the centre letters
centre asks for the middle letters of the word health, the two at its heart

parts.note: a place is a location

explanation.surface: Next to the health centre is a spot set aside for allotment gardening.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Health centre' reads as a clinic, but it is split: only the middle letters of 'health' are wanted, with 'Behind' saying the place word follows them.
explanation.definitionFit: An allotment is a share handed out, which is an allocation.

indicators.note: accepted means the word for One takes in another letter, as a host takes in a guest

parts.note: an ace is a one in cards or dice

indicators.note: first asks for the opening letter of the word neurotic

explanation.surface: A single fussy patient was the first to have a nervous ailment acknowledged.
explanation.walkthrough: 'accepted' puts N, the first letter of 'neurotic', inside ACE.
explanation.definitionFit: Acne is a skin disorder, and a complaint is an ailment or disorder.

clue.text: Left rubbish out on a smaller scale

indicators.note: out has the rubbish spread out around the letter for Left, holding it inside

parts.note: rubbish dropped in the street is litter

explanation.surface: Someone left the rubbish out, but only a small amount of it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' puts L inside LITTER, as if the rubbish were spread out around it.
explanation.definitionFit: Littler is the comparative of little, so it means smaller in size or scale.

clue.text: Complete transport from end to end

parts.note: to transport something is to carry it
from end to end means right through, the whole way across

explanation.surface: Finishing the job of moving goods the whole length of the route.
explanation.definitionFit: To carry through a plan is to bring it to completion, idiom for finish.

definitions.meaning: a snitch is an informer who tells on others
a sign that gives something away is a revealing, betraying sign

explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that the second sense needs the word placed before 'sign' to make the familiar phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: A telltale is a sneak who informs on others; as an adjective it describes a revealing sign.

clue.text: Some pastor, a clerical divine agency

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A churchman is pictured as a vessel of holy guidance.
explanation.definitionFit: An oracle is a medium through which a god speaks, so a divine agency.

definitions.meaning: might is strength or brawn, muscle power
to grumble or gripe, slang usage

explanation.definitionFit: Beef means muscular strength as a noun, and as a slang verb it means to grumble.

indicators.note: trapped means the shortened heather holds the deserter inside it
almost says the last letter of the heather word is dropped

parts.note: erica is the botanical name for heather
a rat is someone who deserts, as rats leave a sinking ship

explanation.surface: Someone who abandoned their post is caught in the heather while roaming about.
explanation.walkthrough: Erica is the botanical genus of heathers; 'almost' drops its final letter and 'trapped' puts the deserter inside what remains.
explanation.definitionFit: Erratic means irregular and unpredictable, straying from a steady course, as wandering does.

definitions.meaning: a bat is a creature that takes to the air after dark
unreliable and irresponsible, especially in business

explanation.walkthrough: The literal phrase describes a bat's habits; the idiom describes a shady, untrustworthy dealer.
explanation.definitionFit: A fly-by-night firm is unreliable and dodges its obligations; literally a bat flies by night.

parts.note: spontaneous behaviour is natural, unforced
gas is idle talk or chatter

explanation.surface: Unforced conversation is presented as the energy that drives a gathering.
explanation.definitionFit: Natural gas is a fossil fuel burned for heating and cooking.

parts.note: ay, also spelt aye, is an old poetic word for always

explanation.surface: A couple constantly pleading with someone.
explanation.definitionFit: To pray is to entreat or beg, so to ask earnestly.

parts.note: a just person is upright, honest and fair
piano is the musical direction for soft

explanation.surface: A modest person is described as fair and quiet rather than lofty, though perhaps noisy.
explanation.walkthrough: PIANO means soft in music, yet the instrument is also loud when played forte, hence the teasing bracket.
explanation.definitionFit: An upright piano has a vertical frame, the domestic alternative to a grand.

clue.text: Cause distaste when shy newcomer comes in

indicators.note: comes in says the newcomer enters the shy word, sitting inside it

parts.note: coy means shy or bashful
L stands for learner, a newcomer, as on L-plates

explanation.surface: A bashful person feels put off when a stranger enters the room.
explanation.definitionFit: To cloy is to sicken through excess sweetness, causing distaste.

clue.text: Heel Patty injured during thoughtful communication

indicators.note: injured says the letters are damaged and put together in a new order

explanation.surface: Patty hurt her heel while passing messages by mind alone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'injured' rearranges the letters of HEEL and PATTY.
explanation.definitionFit: Telepathy is communication of thoughts directly between minds.

clue.text: Round it's carried in case of emergency

definitions.text: Round it's carried in case of emergency

parts.words: Round it's carried in case of emergency
parts.note: round reads as a noun for something circular kept in a car boot for a puncture, not a preposition

explanation.definitionFit: A spare wheel is a round extra kept in a vehicle for use after a puncture.

parts.note: port is the left side of a ship
a cavity is a hole

explanation.surface: An opening has left behind a hollow space.
explanation.definitionFit: A porthole is a small round window in a ship's side, an opening.

clue.text: In Senegal it chiefly produces fruit

indicators.note: In says the answer sits inside the words that follow, across their boundaries

explanation.surface: A West African country is said to grow a particular crop in quantity.
explanation.walkthrough: The run starts at the last letter of 'Senegal' and ends inside 'chiefly'.
explanation.definitionFit: The litchi, or lychee, is a sweet tropical fruit.

indicators.note: about indicates the letters are turned around and moved into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A self-satisfied clue concerning someone who mends rifles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' rearranges the letters of SMUG and HINT.
explanation.definitionFit: A gunsmith makes and repairs guns.

clue.text: Read cut-out article by excellent tabloid

indicators.note: cut-out means the article is snipped out of the word Read

parts.note: a is the indefinite article
top means first-rate, excellent

explanation.surface: Someone peruses a clipped item beside a first-class popular newspaper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut-out' removes A from READ to leave RED. A red top is a British popular tabloid paper, named for its red masthead.
explanation.definitionFit: Red-top is the British name for a downmarket tabloid newspaper, from its red masthead.

parts.note: dun is a dull greyish-brown, dingy colour
kirk is the Scottish word for a church

explanation.surface: A drab chapel stands somewhere on French soil.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is short: the answer is a port in France, the site of the 1940 evacuation.
explanation.definitionFit: Dunkirk is a seaport in northern France, so a place in France.

clue.text: Fruit to come from egg of songbird!

parts.note: a nut is a dry fruit
to hatch is to break out of an egg

explanation.surface: A small bird's chick emerges from its shell.
explanation.definitionFit: The nuthatch is a small climbing songbird.

parts.note: torn means ripped or split
a do is an informal party

explanation.surface: A huge row broke one political group in two.
explanation.definitionFit: A tornado is a violent windstorm, a big blow in the weather sense.

indicators.note: rewriting means the letters are written out again in a new order

explanation.surface: A writer redrafts a page about a footballer who plays out wide.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rewriting' rearranges PAGE and IM; 'about' is a link. Winger reads as a footballer but means a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: A winger here is anything with wings, and the magpie is a bird.

clue.text: Health-giving drink may be served in it

definitions.text: Health-giving drink may be served in it

parts.words: Health-giving drink may be served in it
parts.note: a drink to someone's health is a toast, raised in a vessel made for it

explanation.walkthrough: Health-giving suggests a tonic, but drinking someone's health means toasting them.
explanation.definitionFit: A wine glass is the stemmed vessel raised when drinking a toast.

parts.note: p, for piano, is the musical mark for soft or gentle
the Ure is a river in Yorkshire

explanation.surface: A gently flowing river is free of contamination.
explanation.walkthrough: The URE is a river in North Yorkshire, England.
explanation.definitionFit: Pure means clean and uncontaminated.

definitions.meaning: to tarry is to linger or remain
a guy is a rope or wire used to steady a mast or tent

explanation.definitionFit: Stay means to remain, and a stay is also a supporting rope on a ship's mast.

clue.text: Leave divorcee with the very item

parts.note: an ex is a former spouse
it means the very thing, as in that's it

explanation.surface: Walking out on a former partner, taking the precious thing along.
explanation.definitionFit: To exit is to go out or depart.

clue.text: Abstract style of revolutionary patriot going round California

indicators.note: going round says the rearranged letters surround the state abbreviation
revolutionary hints at overturning, so the letters of patriot are rearranged

explanation.surface: A rebel patriot tours California, painting in a non-figurative manner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revolutionary' rearranges PATRIOT into OPTIART, and 'going round' wraps it around California's abbreviation; optical art is better known as op art.
explanation.definitionFit: Optical art, or op art, is an abstract art movement using visual illusions.

parts.note: Ike was the nickname of US President Eisenhower

explanation.surface: A Liberal admires a US president.
explanation.definitionFit: To like someone is to regard them favourably.

clue.text: Science college has no record by end of day

parts.note: a tech is a technical college
a log is a written record

indicators.note: end of asks for the last letter of the word day

explanation.surface: A college finishes the day without a record.
explanation.definitionFit: Technology is applied science.
